nodes.label: Work matter does not belong in the volumes
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: M: 'if it is work matter, it does not belong in the volumes. if it is subject, it must be included. why must you have me repeat rulings?' The Register records subject matter only; a withdrawn finding about a volume is work matter and the question should not have been put.
